mapper.select: select id, case_id, member_id, case_key, source_flow, diagnosis_category, evidence_status, handoff_reason, requires_human_review, case_status, schema_version, create_time, update_time from ai_case_handoff where member_id = #{memberId} and case_key = #{caseKey} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ai_case_handoff ( case_id, member_id, case_key, source_flow, diagnosis_category, evidence_status, handoff_reason, requires_human_review, case_status, schema_version, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{caseId}, #{memberId}, #{caseKey}, #{sourceFlow}, #{diagnosisCategory}, #{evidenceStatus}, #{handoffReason}, #{requiresHumanReview}, #{caseStatus}, #{schemaVersion}, now(), now() )
